title: This is very cute, but small
text: This is very cute, but small. Yes, the size is in the description, but the price is too high for the size.  I love the way the white is on the tan.  It is not gray, not sure why the listed it as gray, it is more of a dark sand color.  All in all it's a nice planter, not hole in the bottom and no saucer.
